name: @pipeworx/mcp-swisstransport

tools.name: search_stations
tools.description: Search for Swiss public transport stations (train, bus, tram) by name query.

query.description: Station name to search for (e.g., "Zurich HB", "Bern", "Geneva").

tools.name: get_connections
tools.description: Get public transport connections between two Swiss locations. Returns up to the requested number of next departures.

limit.description: Maximum number of connections to return. Defaults to 4.

tools.name: get_stationboard
tools.description: Get the live departure board for a Swiss public transport station.

station.description: Station name or ID to get the departure board for.

limit.description: Maximum number of departures to return. Defaults to 10.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-swisstransport forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the swisstransport pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
